headline: SMPC: DOE ‘embarrassing’ PH on world stage
summary: Semirara Mining and Power Corp. again criticized the Department of Energy for expanding the asset-surrender rule. The company said it sends a discouraging signal to investors ahead of the ASEAN Summit in Manila.
why: Semirara Mining is a Philippine coal miner and power generator, and regulatory rules affecting its assets bear on investor confidence in the local energy sector.
